prerequisites: Basic knowledge of strength of materials
Familiarity with elementary computer programs at user level
Familiarity with common software for effective learning and handling of specific CAD/CAE software

learning_outcomes.text: Students should know how to apply acquired knowledge and problem-solving skills in new or unfamiliar environments within broader (or multidisciplinary) contexts related to their field of study.
Students should be able to communicate their conclusions and the knowledge and ultimate reasons that support them to specialized and non-specialized audiences clearly and unambiguously.
Students should possess the learning skills that will allow them to continue studying in a largely self-directed or autonomous way.

Have adequate knowledge of the scientific and technological aspects of: mathematical, analytical and numerical methods in engineering, electrical engineering, energy engineering, chemical engineering, mechanical engineering, continuum mechanics, industrial electronics, automation, manufacturing, materials, quantitative management methods, industrial informatics, urban planning and infrastructures.
Project, calculate and design products, processes, installations and plants.
Ability for the design and testing of machines.
Ability to design mechanical systems taking into account aspects related to their assembly and the manufacturing of each of their components.
Ability for design and modeling of mechanical systems using parametric 3D software.
Kinematic and dynamic simulation of mechanical assemblies. Optimization and evaluation studies applied to the design of mechanical elements.
Optimization and evaluation studies applied to the design of mechanical elements.
Possess skill in the use of mechanical component databases.

syllabus_topics: Design and virtual modeling of mechanical assemblies
Kinematic and dynamic simulation of mechanical assemblies
Optimization and evaluation studies applied to the design of parts
teaching_methods: Supervised problem-solving sessions using specific software

assessment_methods.method: Oral tests (individual, group, presentation of topics/works, etc.)

assessment_rules: To pass the subject, a total grade equal to or greater than 5 out of 10 (50%) must be obtained. It is an indispensable requirement to obtain a grade of 5 out of 10 in the written test. For differentiated evaluation, students will be assessed based on a comprehensive project (50%) and a theoretical-practical exam (50%).
